newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria seeks top firms for telecom privatisation.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria seeks top firms for telecom privatisation.

text.p: Bulgaria's Prime Minister Zhan Videnov on Friday said he hoped the world's leading telecommunication companies would bid for a 25 percent stake in Bulgarian Telecommunication Company (BTC).
Answering a deputy's query in parliament, Videnov said the government would seek a strategic partner for state-owned BTC.
"The aim is to integrate with such a strategic buyer who can ensure not only additional transit traffic to the BTC but also access to world-class management," Videnov said.

"The optimal option would be a union between a telecommunication giant, one of the world's leaders, and a financial institution which would cooperate closely with the BTC and bring modern technology to the country," he said.
Videnov said the BTC privatisation scheme, which would be realised in the coming months, envisaged launching an international tender for consultancy firms with experience in telecommunications.
He said the national privatisation agency and the World Bank had already started work on the organisation of a tender. -- Liliana Semerdjieva, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
